responsibility: This file implements GCC’s main OpenMP/OpenACC lowering pass from high-level GIMPLE_OMP constructs into lower-level GIMPLE suitable for final expansion. It scans structured regions, builds omp_context trees describing nesting and shared/private data environments, synthesizes communication records and variable remapping for clauses such as private/firstprivate/lastprivate/reduction/allocate, lowers control constructs to explicit runtime-oriented forms, handles target/offload-specific lowering hooks, and also contains the diagnostic pass that rejects invalid jumps into or out of OpenMP/OpenACC structured blocks.
same_name_distinction: Implements the main lowering pass that rewrites high-level GIMPLE_OMP constructs into lower-level forms, builds omp_context data-sharing environments, and performs structured-block diagnostics. Unlike gcc/omp-low.h, it contains the full lowering algorithms and pass bodies, not just a few exported helper declarations.
